n: Sipeed Maixduino and MAix Bit (Kendryte K210)
t: Older Sipeed boards built on the Kendryte K210 chip for embedded AI.
steps: Find the Sipeed wiki and read the Maix series table.
Check that a seller has stock of the board.
Look for working MaixPy documentation. The v1 links did not load.
Connect the board to a Windows, Mac, or Linux computer by USB.
Test a simple program before class.
Plan a backup if the setup fails.
